verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Cake has a stakeholder portal, NSO/ISO support, vesting engine, and dilution modeling for raises, plus an AI/MCP assistant for querying cap table data, but nothing indicates these are packaged as plain-language, employee-facing explanations of tax treatment, exercise windows, or personal dilution impact. missing for 10: employee-facing tax treatment explanations, exercise window guidance, personalized dilution narratives, any UI/doc evidence of 'plain language' equity education for stakeholders (not just admins).
